reference_design.holdout_meaning: Statistical-reference split only. All279 rows participated in VAE/DDPM fitting; none becomes model-unseen/dev or a generalization test.
reference_design.disjointness: No frozen component crosses chosen32 vs remaining247; mixed-terminal components selected jointly, never independent terminal draws followed by union.
reference_design.frozen_group_semantics: Global NW +2/−1/gap−2 including terminal gaps; edge alignment matches/all columns>=0.70, then transitive connected components. Not biological family proof, not all-pairs70%, and residual relatedness remains.
reference_design.covariance_boundary: Each generated16-row1536-dimensional [mu,logsigma] matrix has centered covariance rank<=15. Do not compare raw high-dimensional covariance ranks against fulltrain as error evidence. No covariance matrix, projection, whitening, W2 or shrinkage computed here.

sampler.engine: NumPy1.26.4.PCG64 raw_uint64, single shared generator; exact integer rejection randbelow; no float probabilities
sampler.unit: Whole frozen component across both terminal labels jointly
sampler.component_order: Lexicographically sorted exact component_id; all rows of each component retained together
sampler.algorithm: Integer suffix dynamic programming DP[i,f,a] counts exact feasible subsets of components i..end with remaining FREE=f,AMD=a. At each component, include with take_count/(take_count+skip_count), selected by exact raw-bit randbelow(total)<take_count; deterministic if either count is0. Stop only at(0,0). Thus every feasible complete-component subset has exact probability1/DP[0,16,16]. No rejection based on latent/sequence/quality outcome.
sampler.arbitrary_integer_draw: k=(total−1).bit_length(); concatenate ceil(k/64) PCG64 raw64 values in draw order, mask to k low bits, reject values>=total. Record full PCG64 state before/after each complete subset.
sampler.population_scope: 224 frozen training components, max total size5; none individually exceeds target16 per terminal. All components participate in the DP, no prefilter. Uniform feasible component subsets is NOT uniform sequence sampling or equal component-inclusion probability.
sampler.shared_indices: The same256 joint subsets used for CE and MSE; each repetition gen16 and training statistical-holdout16 use the identical remaining reference.
sampler.seal: Save every selected component/row id, remaining row id, exact subset probability, RNG states, duplicate subsets and empirical inclusion count for all224 groups before loading natural latent arrays or computing metrics. Inclusion counts describe this run, not expected probabilities or inverse-probability weights.
